rows.response_text:
Here is how you can cook a pork sirloin roast in an oven using the provided passages:

1. Heat a tablespoon of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until it starts smoking. Brown the pork sirloin roast on all sides and then place it in a baking dish. (Passage 1)
2. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Season the pork with salt and pepper, and then place it in a roasting pan fitted with a rack or onto a baking sheet, fat side up. (Passage 2)
3. Roast the pork in the oven for approximately 50 to 70 minutes, turning it over halfway through the cooking time. Remove the roast from the oven when the instant-read meat thermometer registers between 145 and 150 degrees Fahrenheit in the thickest portion of the meat. (Passage 3)
4. To add flavor to the pork, you can rub it with different herbs and spices before browning it, or baste it with stock or wine every 15 minutes during the cooking time. (Passage 1 and Passage 2)

I hope this helps! Let me know if you have any other questions.
